mechanism.name: merged-site element-7 witness

where_registered.resolver: forensics/tools/consumer_closure.py:apply_evidence_classes S3m block, immediately after the S3 fetch-slot block

mechanism.why_separate: fetch_slot_witness is single-definition by construction: _reg_origin refuses more than one reaching definition and never unions. The merged site has two reaching loads from the same base, so it needs a separate witness. The single-definition rule is unchanged everywhere else.
accepts_only_when: the call site is enumerated (kind call/jmp, address found in the containing function);
the operand is a register whose reaching-definition set has at least two members;
EVERY reaching definition is a single-offset movq load that writes that register;
every load reads the SAME canonical base register, and every load's base resolves through the already-accepted fetch binding (_base_fetch) to the same family fetch binding;
the base's producer is the family fetch with exactly one family writer (EVP_KEM / evp_kem_from_algorithm);
every member offset is declared in FETCH_FAMILIES[family].fields;
every slot id's field is assigned exactly once in the family source writer;
the justified slot ids are distinct, and the evidence is the per-definition slot list, each justified individually.

refuses_on.operand_not_register_or_short: returns None (not this mechanism; fetch_slot_witness owns the single-definition shape)
refuses_on.entry_value: refusal: the operand register has an entry value
refuses_on.not_a_load: refusal: a reaching definition is not a single-offset load
refuses_on.wrong_destination: refusal: a reaching definition does not write the called register
refuses_on.different_base_values: refusal: the reaching definitions read different base values
refuses_on.base_not_fetch: refusal: the base value is not the family fetch result: <why>
refuses_on.different_families: refusal: the reaching definitions read different fetch families
refuses_on.different_bindings: refusal: the reaching definitions resolve to different fetch bindings
refuses_on.offset_outside_table: refusal: member offset <off> is not declared in the <FAMILY> slot table
refuses_on.writer_not_unique: refusal: slot <OSSL_FUNC_*> does not resolve to exactly one in-image writer: <why>
refuses_on.fewer_than_two_slots: refusal: the merged site does not justify two distinct slot ids

mechanism.not_a_relaxation: It replaces 'exactly one reaching definition' with 'every reaching definition independently justified'; it never unions target sets and never weakens another witness's single-definition rule.
